title: Getting his first trombone at 14 in Decatur
summary: He picks up a trombone his brother bought, has his sister buy him one, and teaches himself; earlier he played bugle tunes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: When did you begin playing the trombone?

Oh, I think I was about probably 14. My brother was teaching at Morris Brown College. Well, I had moved from Georgia then, from Social Circle. We were living in Decatur like, you know, New York and Brooklyn. So, he was teaching tailoring and he bought a trombone. So I snuck up a couple of notes on it and I liked it and told my sister to buy me one. So she did. The guy delivered it that night about 8 o'clock. No case. The next morning I had the kids out in the backyard dancing in their bare feet. I never had no any lessons.
You never had any lessons? Just taught yourself?
So your brother was teaching tailoring at Morris Brown College and Decatur is just outside of Atlanta. So it was because of his having a trombone that you got ...

I just happened to pick it up and liked it and kept on playing it. I was playing bugle before that. I paid played a dollar for a bugle and I played tunes on the bugle with my aunt. That was when I was going to church ... a man in a restaurant, I gave him a dollar for it. I was playing tunes ... no valves, no nothing. GAMES Used your hands ...
